prompt:

Return ONE altered image with the EXACT SAME 4:5 framing, geometry, textured painted style and positions. Make exactly the five specified meaningful object edits below. Keep absolutely everything else unchanged, including background, all edges, decorations and lighting. Do not redraw or reframe the scene. 2. Edit only this object so: The crescent on her shoulder became a star. Target near x13%, y16%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
3. Edit only this object so: Her near hand gained a small gold ring. Target near x47%, y61%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
4. Edit only this object so: The tiny star below her hand disappeared. Target near x36%, y73%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
5. Edit only this object so: The lone cottage on the upper-right cliff gained a blue roof. Target near x85%, y18%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
review: Visually reviewed. Only the five declared object regions are composited over the original; labels describe actual generated changes. See edits for final accepted answers.
